verdict.rationale: Hightouch's warehouse-native design keeps customer data in the user's own warehouse: Events and Identity Resolution outputs land there and can be queried directly, and a community report says no data is stored in Hightouch by default. Workspace resources can also be managed through Git Sync and a REST API, which reduces lock-in. However, there is no documented export or offboarding feature, and the formats are never specified. missing for 10: an explicit documented full-account export (configs, audiences, journeys, AI Decisioning state) in named open formats, offboarding/exit documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration of leaving.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Hightouch Events collects customer behavior from websites, mobile apps, and backend systems, then stores that data in your warehouse.
It runs on top of your data warehouse, so teams can use customer data without copying it into a separate system.
Query these directly, build models on them in Customer Studio, or sync them downstream.
Git Sync lets you manage workspace resources programmatically.
Hightouch exposes a REST API that lets users interact with resources like syncs, models, sources, and destinations.
